reports.scenario: authentication plus real company list repository
statements: with matches as ( select c.id, c.name, c.industry, c.type, c.specializations, c.location, c.slots, c.description, coalesce(i.url, '/getHiredLogo.png') as image, c.website, c.email, c.phone, c.hours, c.status from gethired_private.companies c left join gethired_private.company_images i on i.id = c.image_id where true ), page as (select * from matches order by lower(name), id limit $1 offset $2) select (select count(*)::int from matches) as total, coalesce((select json_agg(page order by lower(name), id) from page),'[]'::json) as data
